name: plain-copy
what: Phrases that read as machine-written are reported with file, line and a plain alternative, while code, noun uses and allowed words are left alone.

faults.fault: Every match is skipped as if its word were on the allow list.
The noun use of leverage is reported along with the verb.
Fenced code is scanned because the fence is closed as soon as it opens.
Inline code spans are scanned like prose.
